# TavBook AI
> The world's largest AI tools directory — 116,000+ verified AI tools across 500+ categories. Discover, compare, and search the best AI for any task.

TavBook (https://tavbook.top) is an independent AI tools directory. Content is editorially curated, updated daily, and free to use.

## Core

- [Homepage — search 116,000+ AI tools](https://tavbook.top): Full directory with live search, category browsing, and pricing filters.
- [AI research hub](https://tavbook.top/research): Data and trends across the tracked AI tools directory.
- [Blog — guides and research](https://tavbook.top/blog): Editorial guides on the best AI tools.
- [Rankings by category](https://tavbook.top/rankings): Category leaderboards for AI writing, image, video, coding, and more.
- [Head-to-head comparisons](https://tavbook.top/compare): Side-by-side AI tool comparisons.

## Data

- [Tools dictionary (JSON)](https://tavbook.top/tools-dictionary.json): Machine-readable index of every tool.
- [Top tools bundle (JSON)](https://tavbook.top/tools-api.json): Compact bundle with categories, top tools, and metadata.
- [Search API (JSON)](https://tavbook.top/search-api.json): Paginated server-side search over the full catalog.
- [Sitemap index](https://tavbook.top/sitemap.xml): Root sitemap with links to per-section sitemaps.

## Featured guides

- [Best AI Tools in 2026 — Complete Guide](https://tavbook.top/blog/best-ai-tools-2026)
